list_child.name: lsBkg
list_child.desc: This tool lists every class booking on the front desk schedule, across all members and all class types. It gives a broad view of everything currently booked at the gym.

decoys.name: lsBilling
decoys.desc: This tool lists every class booking on the monthly billing run, across all members and all class types. It gives a broad view of the class fees about to be charged.

decoys.name: lsPayroll
decoys.desc: This tool lists every class booking on the instructor pay sheet, across all members and all class types. It gives a broad view of the sessions instructors will be paid for.

decoys.name: lsSurveys
decoys.desc: This tool lists every class booking on the feedback survey queue, across all members and all class types. It gives a broad view of the sessions awaiting a member rating.

get_child.name: getBkg
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single class booking record when given its id. It returns all details, including the class name, state, and session time associated with that booking.

decoys.name: getRcpt
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the payment receipt for a single class booking when given its id. It returns all details, including the amount, card type, and date charged for that booking.

decoys.name: getWaiver
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the signed liability waiver for a single class booking when given its id. It returns all details, including the signature, date, and health answers given for that booking.

decoys.name: getRating
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the member feedback rating for a single class booking when given its id. It returns all details, including the score, comment, and instructor named for that booking.

list_parent.name: lsMbr
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every member on the gym's membership roll, along with their basic contact information. It is how the front desk looks up which member a particular booking belongs to.

decoys.name: lsFreeze
decoys.desc: This tool lists every member on the membership freeze register, along with their basic contact information. It is how the front desk sees who has paused their plan for travel or injury.

decoys.name: lsPT
decoys.desc: This tool lists every member on the personal training client list, along with their basic contact information. It is how the trainers see which members they coach one to one.

decoys.name: lsLocker
decoys.desc: This tool lists every member on the locker rental register, along with their basic contact information. It is how the front desk sees who holds a rented locker in the changing rooms.

get_parent.name: getMbr
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches one member's membership profile using their member id. It is typically used after finding a member's id through the membership roll.

decoys.name: getPlan
decoys.desc: This tool fetches one member's billing plan using their member id. It is typically used to check the monthly rate and renewal date on the account.

decoys.name: getVisits
decoys.desc: This tool fetches one member's visit history using their member id. It is typically used to see how often the member has scanned in at reception.

decoys.name: getHealth
decoys.desc: This tool fetches one member's health questionnaire using their member id. It is typically used before a trainer starts a new program with the member.

delete_child.name: delBkg
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a class booking record from the schedule, and the deletion is final. It is used when a booking was entered in error and has to be wiped from the gym's records.

decoys.name: voidFee
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids the class fee charged on a booking, and the void is final. It is used when a member was billed by mistake and the charge has to be wiped from their account.

decoys.name: delWaiver
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the liability waiver signed for a class booking, and the deletion is final. It is used when a waiver was signed on the wrong form and has to be wiped from the files.

decoys.name: purgeRating
decoys.desc: This tool permanently purges the member feedback rating left on a class booking, and the purge is final. It is used when a rating breaks review policy and has to be wiped from the instructor's scores.

set_enum.name: setBkgState
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a class booking's state among booked, attended, no-show, or cancelled. Use it whenever the outcome of a scheduled class session needs to be recorded.

decoys.name: predictBkgState
decoys.desc: This tool records a class booking's predicted state among booked, attended, no-show, or cancelled for the attendance forecast. Use it whenever instructors plan class numbers for the week ahead.

decoys.name: disputeBkgState
decoys.desc: This tool opens a dispute on a class booking's state among booked, attended, no-show, or cancelled, naming the state the member claims. Use it whenever a member contests a fee at the front desk.

decoys.name: watchBkgState
decoys.desc: This tool sets a reminder that fires when a class booking reaches a state among booked, attended, no-show, or cancelled. Use it whenever an instructor wants to follow up with a member after class.

set_bool.name: flagWaitlist
set_bool.desc: This tool moves a class booking onto the waitlist for its session. It is typically used when a class has filled up and a member's booking needs to be bumped to the queue.

decoys.name: flagTrial
decoys.desc: This tool marks a class booking as a free trial session for its member. It is typically used when a prospect is trying out a class before buying a membership.

decoys.name: flagGuest
decoys.desc: This tool marks a class booking as a guest pass visit for its session. It is typically used when a member brings a friend along on one of their guest passes.

decoys.name: flagAssist
decoys.desc: This tool marks a class booking as needing an assisted spot for its session. It is typically used when a member needs adapted equipment or instructor support in class.

set_ref.name: moveMbr
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns a class booking from one member's account to a different member's account entirely. Use it when a booking was logged under the wrong member and needs to move.

decoys.name: billMbr
decoys.desc: This tool bills the fee for a class booking to a different member's account entirely. Use it when a family plan holder pays for a relative's class and wants the charge on their own account.

decoys.name: buddyMbr
decoys.desc: This tool links a class booking to a different member's account as a buddy booking. Use it when two members want to be placed side by side in the same class session.

decoys.name: referMbr
decoys.desc: This tool credits a class booking as a referral to a different member's account. Use it when an existing member brought in the new client and earns the referral reward.

send.name: callMbr
send.desc: This tool places an outbound call to a gym member using the phone number on file. It is used to reach a member directly about a class booking or their account in general.
child_verbs: give the member of {obj} a ring

decoys.name: textMbr
decoys.desc: This tool sends an outbound text message to a gym member using the phone number on file. It is used to reach a member quickly about a class booking or their account in general.
child_verbs: send the member of {obj} a text

decoys.name: mailMbr
decoys.desc: This tool mails a printed letter to a gym member at the postal address on file. It is used to reach a member formally about a class booking or their account in general.
child_verbs: mail a letter to the member of {obj}
post a letter to the member of {obj}

decoys.name: pushMbr
decoys.desc: This tool sends a push notification to a gym member through the gym's mobile app. It is used to reach a member instantly about a class booking or their account in general.
child_verbs: push a notification to the member of {obj}
send an app alert to the member of {obj}

create.name: newBkg
create.desc: This tool creates a new class booking for a member, with an optional class name and starting state. It is used when a member signs up for a session at the front desk or online.

decoys.name: newPT
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new personal training session for a member, with an optional class name and starting state. It is used when a member books one-to-one time with a trainer.

decoys.name: newTour
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new facility tour for a member, with an optional class name and starting state. It is used when a member brings a prospect in to see the gym.

decoys.name: newAssess
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new fitness assessment for a member, with an optional class name and starting state. It is used when a member wants measurements and goals taken.

list_notes.name: lsBkgNotes
list_notes.desc: This tool lists the notes attached to a single class booking. It includes every remark front desk staff and instructors have logged against that booking.

decoys.name: lsBkgInjuries
decoys.desc: This tool lists the injury reports attached to a single class booking. It includes every incident instructors have logged during that booking's session.

decoys.name: lsBkgCharges
decoys.desc: This tool lists the charges attached to a single class booking. It includes every fee and refund the billing team has logged against that booking.

decoys.name: lsBkgFeedback
decoys.desc: This tool lists the feedback comments attached to a single class booking. It includes every rating and remark the member has left about that session.

add_note.name: addBkgNote
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a class booking, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks from the front desk or the instructor about that booking.

decoys.name: addBkgInjury
decoys.desc: This tool files a new injury report on a class booking, with an optional title. It is used to record an incident that happened during that booking's session.

decoys.name: addBkgFeedback
decoys.desc: This tool adds member feedback to a class booking, with an optional title. It is used to record what the member said about the class after the session.

decoys.name: addBkgRequest
decoys.desc: This tool adds a special request to a class booking, with an optional title. It is used to record things like a preferred bike or mat position for that booking.

update_note.name: editBkgNote
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a class booking. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: replyBkgNote
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply, with text and an optional title, under an existing note on a class booking. It is used when an instructor answers a remark left by the front desk.

decoys.name: resolveBkgNote
decoys.desc: This tool resolves an existing note on a class booking with closing text and an optional title. It is used once the issue raised in a remark has been handled.

decoys.name: escalateBkgNote
decoys.desc: This tool escalates an existing note on a class booking to the gym manager with text and an optional title. It is used when a remark needs a manager's decision.

delete_note.name: delBkgNote
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a class booking. The note is erased from the gym's records for good.

decoys.name: redactBkgNote
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the wording of a note on a class booking. The text is blacked out in the gym's records for good.

decoys.name: purgeBkgThread
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes the replies posted under a note on a class booking. The thread is erased from the gym's records for good.

decoys.name: detachBkgFile
decoys.desc: This tool permanently detaches the file attached to a note on a class booking. The file is erased from the gym's records for good.

set_image.name: setBkgImg
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a class booking record. It is typically a promotional photo of the class taken by the gym's marketing team.

decoys.name: setBkgPass
decoys.desc: This tool sets the check-in pass image on a class booking record. It is typically the QR code the member scans at the front desk.

decoys.name: setBkgForm
decoys.desc: This tool sets the scanned waiver form image on a class booking record. It is typically a photo of the paper form the member signed.

decoys.name: setBkgBadge
decoys.desc: This tool sets the achievement badge image on a class booking record. It is typically the milestone graphic shown after a member's tenth class.

writer.name: writeMsg
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the class bookings it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writePromo
decoys.desc: This tool writes a class promotion post from a brief, which states the offer in the marketer's own words, and the class bookings it should feature. It returns the finished post.

decoys.name: writeRecap
decoys.desc: This tool writes a class recap email from a brief, which states the highlights in the instructor's own words, and the class bookings it should cover. It returns the finished recap.

decoys.name: writePlan
decoys.desc: This tool writes a workout plan from a brief, which states the goals in the trainer's own words, and the class bookings it should build on. It returns the finished plan.

image.name: genImg
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: genFlyer
decoys.desc: This tool designs a class flyer from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the flyer.

decoys.name: genBadge
decoys.desc: This tool draws an achievement badge from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the badge.

decoys.name: genFloor
decoys.desc: This tool draws a studio floor layout from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the layout.

search.name: searchKb
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the booking system works.

decoys.name: searchPolicy
decoys.desc: This tool searches the membership policy handbook with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check the rules on freezes and refunds.

decoys.name: searchMoves
decoys.desc: This tool searches the exercise library with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how a movement should be performed.

decoys.name: searchTimetable
decoys.desc: This tool searches the published class timetable with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to find when and where a class runs.
